files.title: Logo URLs
files.description: Direct links to square-ish logos (PNG, SVG, JPG, WebP). One complete favicon set per image. 512×512 or larger (or SVG) looks best.

appName.title: App name
appName.description: Name written into site.webmanifest. Defaults to the file name.

themeColor.title: Theme colour
themeColor.description: 6-digit hex colour for the manifest and for the Apple/maskable icon background when the logo is transparent.

background.title: Icon background
background.description: Optional 6-digit hex colour behind the logo on every icon. Leave empty to keep transparency.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: Outline of the browser and Android icons. The Apple touch icon is always square (iOS rounds it).

fit.title: Fit
fit.description: How a non-square logo fills the icon.

paddingPercent.title: Padding (%)
paddingPercent.description: Empty space around the logo on each side, as a percentage of the icon size.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
